attempts.name: ResumeV1
attempts.prompt:
Create a replacement animation sheet, eight complete full-body sprites, FOUR columns and TWO rows, true transparent background. Reference1 is the exact character and dual-saw EQUIPMENT authority; replace its repeated-leg animation. Reference2 is the approved Katana identity and compact adult BODY proportions; use his same head/body ratio, face, haircut, clothing and boots.

This sheet is a slow natural SIDEWAYS WALK, not marching. Row1 walks WEST toward LEFT; row2 walks EAST toward RIGHT. Lock each row to one invariant SIDE camera, one invariant visible shoulder/hip, one invariant torso width. Do not rotate the chest between frames. Each of the 8 sprites must be independently drawn whole from head to boots with both complete hand-held circular saws; never assemble parts.

Make TWO visibly OPPOSITE CONTACT silhouettes per row:
COLUMN1: the CAMERA-SIDE thigh reaches FORWARD in walking direction, CAMERA-SIDE boot in front of hips; the HIDDEN-SIDE leg reaches BACK.
COLUMN2: camera-side boot planted directly below hip, hidden-side boot glides past ankle with toe just clearing ground.
COLUMN3: the CAMERA-SIDE thigh visibly slopes BACKWARD from the SAME visible hip, CAMERA-SIDE boot BEHIND hips; HIDDEN-SIDE thigh slopes FORWARD and its boot is in front. Here the visible leg must form the BACK diagonal of an X, unlike column1 where it formed the FRONT diagonal. The far boot must be readable as coming from the far hip, with its upper thigh disappearing behind the near thigh. Preserve the torso camera while exchanging the two legs' fore/aft positions. A repetition of the camera-side leg forward is an animation failure.
COLUMN4: hidden-side boot planted below hip; camera-side boot glides low past the planted ankle.
Both contact poses keep leading heel touching the ground and trailing toe touching ground; stride only one boot length. The passing foot clears by a few pixels, knees low, pelvis only tiny vertical motion. Short proportional adult legs match reference2. No high-knee bends or airborne boots. Keep both legs and their hip-knee-ankle paths distinct.

Keep EXACTLY the same size crown, compact brown layered hair volume and crown-to-belt length in all8; adult angular stern face, dark-red iris, clean warm skin [246,174,130], black long coat with narrow red trim and dark-red lining, silver hip chain, black strapped leather boots. Two silver-toothed black circular motor saws, one firmly gripped in each hand, same unchanged size and design through cycle, held low beside hips with subtle natural counter-swing, not attacking. Arms must not hide all thigh ownership. Match reference1 equipment, not katana or gauntlets. Normal form, no glow, no bike, no armor greaves. Entire figures and complete weapons inside separate spacious cells, no clipping, no text, no grid lines, crisp detailed pixel art, no blur.

attempts.name: ResumeBOnlyV2
attempts.prompt:
Make FOUR COMPLETE sprites only, 2 columns x2 rows, transparent background. This is a targeted correction of the two missing animation phases, not another copy of the reference sheet. Keep the reference character EXACTLY: same constant side torso camera, head, compact brown hair, adult compact body, skin/eyes, black/red coat and BOTH hand-held circular saws. No torso turn.

Top row faces LEFT. Bottom row faces RIGHT.
LEFT COLUMN = OPPOSITE FOOT CONTACT. The leg closest to us MUST be the BACK leg. The thigh clearly visible on our side of the pelvis extends BACKWARDS, away from the direction the nose points. Its knee is behind the belt and its boot is even farther behind. The OTHER, far-side leg comes FORWARD from behind the near thigh; the far boot is the leading boot in front of the belt. Keep the rear near leg exposed so its backward thigh, knee and ankle are visibly connected. This means on top row the NEAR knee and boot are to the RIGHT of belt; on bottom row the NEAR knee and boot are to the LEFT of belt. The far leg is opposite. Both boots low, forward heel touches floor and back toe touches floor, small normal walking stride. Same side chest/shoulder camera as reference, no back view.
RIGHT COLUMN = NEXT LOW PASSING POSE. Far leg planted below pelvis. Near leg swings forward from the back, its foot barely lifted and now close to planted ankle. Knee never lifted above planted knee; no march or kick.

Critical: do not repeat the reference's near leg in front. Only four full new whole figures with near-side BACKWARD leg on first column, all heads, hands, full saws and boots intact, same size throughout. No text, no extra figures, no geometric mockup. Crisp pixel art matching reference.
